sample_fp16_vs_batched_fp32.note: Cross-precision spot check only; not validation against the grader reference.

timing_caveats: Projected frame count comes from metadata, not decoding all 1650 videos.
Selected video bytes and sample output used temporary RAM-backed storage; Parquet extraction was timed separately on the actual dataset filesystem.
Checkpoint loading/warmup and final gzip are outside clip timers.
20% scheduling headroom is a planning allowance, not a runtime guarantee.
FP16 comparison uses batched FP32, not the grader reference.
Longer checks deliberately include two slower landscape videos and a median-throughput video, so they are not an additional unbiased sample.
